messages.subject: Error in extracting mode
parts:
Hi all
I am facing an error in extracting mode.
here is the command
> plot(fit1$capthist, add=T)
> spdf <- fxi.contour(fit1, i = 1:18,X = c(1895093,2239181),add = TRUE, plotmode = TRUE, plt = T, p = c(0.5,0.95),border=10000, nx = 256, SPDF = TRUE, fitmode = TRUE,fill = topo.colors(4))
> modes<- t(sapply(spdf, "[[", "mode"))
Error in as.list.default(X) : 
  no method for coercing this S4 class to a vector

Please let me know where I am wrong??

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in extracting mode
parts:
Don't set SPDF = TRUE unless you want a SpatialPolygonsDataFrame. A SpatialPolygonsDataFrame has no 'mode' component for you to extract.

Further gratuitous advice: only use fxi.contour if you are really sure you know what it does, and that's what you want!

Murray
